item.title: US refineries taking in half of Venezuela’s oil output, official says
item.description: US official says Venezuela is sending 500,000 of its 1.25 million barrels per day output to Gulf Coast refineries.

item.title: How Ebola became the deadliest outbreak in DR Congo’s history
item.description: Conflict, delayed detection, and mistrust are complicating efforts to contain the virus in eastern DR Congo.

item.title: US ambassador to Israel calls settler violence ‘terror’
item.description: US Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee says Israeli settler violence in the occupied West Bank

item.title: Quebec separatist says no independence referendum while Trump in office
item.description: Leader of Canadian province's secessionist party says debate over independence stymied by turbulence in US politics.

item.title: Iran war live: Trump denies Iran talks, Tehran claims US ‘begging’
item.description: Trump says no talks with Tehran scheduled; Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi claims US 'begging' for negotiations.

item.title: Al Jazeera reports from Indonesia’s quake zone, desperate for help
item.description: Thousands are still displaced on Indonesia’s Flores Island after a 7.7-magnitude earthquake killed at least 70 people.

item.title: Democrats call for USS Lincoln probe, question US Navy’s readiness
item.description: Lawmakers question whether conditions on the aircraft carrier indicate a 'pattern' of poor planning amid the Iran war.

item.title: Minnesota official sues Texas governor to force ICE agent’s extradition
item.description: State Attorney General Keith Ellison has called for the transfer of ICE agent accused of lying about nonfatal shooting.

item.title: Bolivia arrests political adviser to Latin American right-wingers
item.description: Arrest comes after attack on activist Nadia Beller, who says she was targeted for her opposition to corruption.

item.title: Trump administration moves to end rule protecting swaths of forest land
item.description: US Agriculture Department says rescinding 2001 rule will help reduce wildfire risk and return control to local managers.

item.title: Why is the US ramping up Tomahawk production?
item.description: The Pentagon has contracted a defence manufacturer to increase the output of cruise missiles.

item.title: Syria opens Assad-era nuclear programme to UN probe
item.description: UN watchdog reports that it found large amounts of material at undisclosed sites in Syria.

item.title: DR Congo’s Ebola outbreak ‘global emergency’ as infections pass 5,000: WHO
item.description: Officials warn they are continuing to identify new chains of transmission that need to be broken to stop the spread.

item.title: Trump says no talks planned with Iran amid anger over Iran-Oman Hormuz deal
item.description: US president hits out as states bordering the Strait of Hormuz continue talks on managing the strategic waterway.

item.title: Israeli strike reported to kill at least six in Gaza City
item.description: The strike comes as efforts to push an agreement aimed at ending hostilities remain stalled.

item.title: WHO: Ebola can be contained in months if enough funding is provided
item.description: The World Health Organization says the Ebola outbreak in DR Congo can be brought under control in three months.

item.title: Russia reports Ukrainian drone strike near Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant
item.description: Concern over the security of Europe's largest nuclear plant has been rife since Russia launched its full-scale war.

item.title: Jose Mourinho returns to Real Madrid in closed-door ceremony
item.description: In an unusually private ceremony, Jose Mourinho has officially begun his second spell as Real Madrid manager.

item.title: Liberia to take 1,200 deportees from the US
item.description: The first group of 20 deportees is expected to arrive in the coming days.

item.title: Russian missile strike kills 10 civilians in Kharkiv
item.description: A Russian missile strike on Pechenihy, in Ukraine’s Kharkiv region, killed at least 10 civilians and wounded 17 others.

item.title: Trump and Carney speak ahead of US tariff deadline
item.description: The new US tariffs would cover about $20bn worth of imports and could lead to job losses and business closures.

item.title: US sanctions International Criminal Court president and trial lawyer
item.description: The Trump administration has led a campaign to 'dismantle' the court, calling it a threat to national sovereignty.

item.title: US Justice Department denies whistleblower claims on anti-Semitism probes
item.description: Ivy League schools were pressured into settlements despite a lack of evidence, according to a former DOJ lawyer.

item.title: Turkish politician Melih Meric stabbed
item.description: Footage shows the moment Turkish New Party MP Melih Meric got into an argument with a man who stabbed him.

item.title: US seeks to revive criminal case against Kilmar Abrego Garcia
item.description: Judge previously found US government brought charges against Abrego Garcia as retaliation for case that embarrassed it.
